entries.title: The Midnight Cauldron
entries.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE original standalone landscape 16:9 still mock for a spooky Halloween ambience video.
The attached input is a drawing-language and mood reference only. Follow its hand-inked antique storybook / woodcut linework, restrained warm ink on black night, simple charming figures and candle glow. Invent the scene below, with new characters and layout rather than reproducing the reference's cats-around-pumpkin composition.
Art direction: true nighttime, majority near-black negative space. Palette only near-black, muted warm sepia/taupe and pale amber candlelight. No blue, green, pink or rainbow colors. No moon, daylight, sunrise or orange sky. Fine irregular hatching inside a few main forms, subtle paper grain, bold readable outer silhouettes, quiet cozy eerie mood. Flat drawn illustration, no photography, 3D or polished digital gradients.
Visual hierarchy: the primary creature/characters and their action must be immediately recognizable at thumbnail size. Subject group roughly 50-65 percent image height, distinct face and contours, warm light concentrated around one focal source. Background subordinate, dark and simplified; only minimal setting cues with very low contrast. Preserve generous dark air around heads. No dense forest, elaborate buildings, busy foliage or repeated decorations.
No text, caption, labels, signature, logo, watermark, frame, inset panel or collage.
Distinct scene: Two small black cats in ragged witch capes stir a small round cauldron over a low candle-colored fire. One cat holds a wooden spoon, the other peers over the rim with two pale oval eyes. Asymmetric grouping in the lower center, cats and cauldron clearly separate, no hats needed. Just two faint tree trunks at the extreme edges. Keep the bubbling cauldron, expressive faces and long tails as clear shapes; a small low amber light pool.
